items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I remember Louis Armstrong, Johnny Tessiturn had Louis Armstrong eat at the Coliseum Arena.

ctx.x: Well how was he playing when you were with him?

He was playing good. He was terrific then. Because I remember Louis Armstrong, Johnny Tessiturn had Louis Armstrong eat at the Coliseum Arena. And then he came over to the tea room because him and Rene was buddies. And by the way my daddy was the first manager of the Coliseum Arena. Really? But he wouldn't keep it and he said he just told the man, he was a friend of the owner, I don't remember his name. He said I just want to give a dance or two here. I remember the dance he gave there. Louis Armstrong played the…

Yeah he had, doing good range. Could he make those pedal tones? Yes. Could he get down low? He was in full action of his horn. He was playing every night, seven nights a week. I got an album of Rene at my house. Well do you think that sounded anything like it?
